source_training_protocol.training_provenance: New from-scratch same-capacity runs, selected main hyperparameters and seeds. Do not associate their time with main-run accuracy.
source_training_protocol.inference_provenance: Original saved main checkpoints, common fixed training memory, actual batch size 1. No test targets passed to model.
source_training_protocol.training_population: Full training split for all single-stage models; RATL earlier base and later residual partitions with its original 11-session separation.
source_training_protocol.training_time_definition: Sum of measured fit stages plus RATL gamma validation/cache/checkpoint stage. Includes validation, training cache refresh, checkpoint I/O and bookkeeping; excludes model initialization and directly measured GPU-monitor call time.
source_training_protocol.retrieval_time_definition: Query-key encoding, mature-candidate mask, similarity and Top-K; excludes response fusion. HistoricalMean has no retrieval timer.
source_training_protocol.inference_time_definition: Synchronized wall time of one resident-on-GPU query through full forward, cache prebuilt; excludes host/device transfer, cache preparation and monitor calls.
source_training_protocol.preprocessing_note: No reference construction is rerun; model initialization and inference memory preparation are separately timed.
source_training_protocol.memory_size_note: canonical_memory_mb counts cached retrieval keys and target values (RATL: cached keys plus residuals); input and cache tensor bytes are also listed. This excludes model weights, workspace, full resident dataset, and allocator/context overhead.
source_training_protocol.exclusivity_limit: GPU 0 idle before allocation; PID/memory checks and companion GPU idle checks throughout for [2, 3]. Other GPUs and host CPU activity are not controlled. This does not prove whole-host exclusivity.

alignment: Training cost, test errors, and batch-one latency refer to the same common-memory efficiency checkpoint.
